Introducing SoulReaper, an epic Minecraft combat plugin that takes PvP and PvE to a whole new level, delivering a dark, intense, and highly rewarding gameplay experience.

⚔️ Soul Scythe — The Reaper’s Weapon At the heart of the plugin lies the Soul Scythe, a mystical scythe that evolves alongside the player. It’s not just a cosmetic item — it serves as the main tool for channeling devastating powers and unlocking new stages of strength.

️ Soul-Based Progression System Nothing comes for free. To unleash the true power of the Reaper, players must collect souls through kills. As they progress, new abilities become available:

-  Strike — launches a fast zigzagging magical projectile.
-  Wind — creates a powerful shockwave that pushes nearby enemies away.
-  Guardian — summons three orbital rings that protect the player.
-  Omniscient — grants tactical teleportation with a ghost-like effect.
-  Apocalypse — calls down a devastating meteor from the sky.
-  Timelord — freezes and slows enemies within an area.
-  Darkness — curses opponents with blindness and decay.
-  Death — the ultimate ability: fires a deadly projectile that extracts the target’s soul with a dramatic ascending spiral effect, dealing massive damage.

⚙️ Fully Configurable and Balanced SoulReaper was also designed with server administrators in mind, offering full control through a clean and intuitive config.yml.

- ✔️ Fully customizable damage values for every ability.
- ✔️ Adjustable cooldown system for balanced PvP gameplay.
- ✔️ Configurable progression and kill requirements.
- ✔️ Smart gameplay integration — special abilities can respect or ignore Creative Mode and bosses depending on the admin’s settings.

️ Administrative Tools The plugin also includes powerful admin commands to manage player progression, add or remove souls, monitor statistics, and track the evolution of every Reaper on the server.
